recovery.rationale: Only the exact captured source files are restored. Source definitions/formulas and dependency evidence are retained; existing app/environment bindings are prerequisites, never recreated or inferred.

unverifiedDependencyGroups.rationale: Qualified callable usage proves an external/namespace binding is required, not that it exists. Connection metadata/credentials are outside file recovery and are not guessed.
